messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: [severity=P2] High rate of CUDA OOMs on runtime-pool-7 (node-7). 30 OOMs in 5m. Affected model: llama-13b-q4. Auto-mitigation suggestions queued.
lee: oncall here, starting triage. which shard/node specifically?
mira: node-7, gpu0. I see `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in container logs but nvml reports ~400MB free.
sam: that sounds like fragmentation / pinned reserved blocks. can you paste `runtimectl debug memory --node node-7 --gpu 0`?
mira: pasted below:
```
Reserved blocks: 3.1 GiB
Used (active allocations): 9.4 GiB
Free (nvml): 0.4 GiB
Sparepool: 512 MiB
KV cache pinned: 2.0 GiB
Slab fragmentation: 18% (high)
```
lee: so headroom exists but reserved/pinned blocks eat usable space. customer errors?
elena: yes, several requests 503 from customers: acct_88, acct_212. CS pinged.
raj: I'm going to disable KV cache reservation on node-7 to free pinned blocks. Command: `runtimectl node-annotate node-7 no-kvcache-reserve=true`
mira: +1 but need a graceful eviction first for running inferences. start drain?
sam: order of ops: 1) mark node drain 2) evict new jobs 3) trigger kvcache eviction 4) full restart of inference-runner if OOM persists.
lee: do the drain now. `rctl drain node-7 --reason "oom-frag-pinned"`
incident-bot: ACTION: node-7 set to DRAINING by lee. Notifying scheduler.
raj: kvcache eviction triggered: `runtimectl cache-evict --node node-7 --policy=aggressive --target=2g`
mira: logs show kvcache eviction freeing ~1.8GiB pinned in 30s. nvml free jumps to 2.1GiB.
elena: reporting back to CS: mitigation in progress, 503s reduced but still some tail.
sam: check allocator slabs: `runtimectl debug slab --node node-7`
mira: slab dump shows many small pinned chunks from previous quantized allocations; rescanning to coalesce.
lee: after eviction, one remaining OOM on gpu0 at 1968010501. Container crashed and restarted by orchestrator. Any root cause?
s am: crash trace shows failure allocating 128MB `alloc_chunk(134217728)`; allocator tried to split reserved block but had fragmentation. The reserve map shows several tiny free segments not contiguous.
raj: to reduce fragmentation we'll temporarily reduce `reserve_block_size` from 512MiB to 256MiB on node-7. Command: `runtimectl config set node-7 reserve_block_size=256MiB`
mira: applied. also enabled `aggressive-coalesce=true` for the allocator to merge adjacent free ranges.
lee: rolling traffic to node-8 and node-9 while node-7 finishes cleanup. `trafficctl shift --from node-7 --to node-8,node-9 --percent 100 --now`
elena: customer update: we shifted traffic; most customers see normal responses. CS wants ETA to fully recover.
lee: give them 20-30m to stabilize, we'll do a handoff in 30m if still open.
incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation steps performed: drain node-7, cache-evict 1.8GB, reduce reserve_block_size, enabled coalesce. Observed decrease in OOM rate by 90%.
mira: after coalesce and reserve change, no further OOMs in 10m. NVML shows 3.0GiB free.
sam: follow-up: we should add a check to surface high pinned-kv percentage vs nvml headroom in the headroom reporter. created issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4572
raj: also recommend adding an automated kvcache eviction when pinned > 50% and headroom < 1GiB.
lee: agreed. for now I'll keep node-7 drained until tomorrow 06:00 UTC for full memory defrag reboot.
elena: CS notified; they'll send a courtesy note to impacted accounts with a short postmortem.
lee: thanks everyone. handoff to night oncall @mira. I'll leave the incident channel open.
mira: taking over for night. monitoring set. please escalate if OOMs reappear. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. root cause: fragmentation + KV cache pinned reserves causing effective loss of headroom despite NVML free.
